title: factory: a TODO runs to a mergeable pull request
name: Factory
line: Commit a TODO; it blinks while Smithers works, you watch the agent, and its pull request is mergeable, with checks and a deploy warning.

chapters.label: Edit the draft and commit it
Smithers starts working on it: the TODO blinks
Watch the agent work on Cloudflare
The agent writes the change and opens a pull request
The pull request is open and mergeable on GitHub
Open the pull request: Merge warns that merging deploys
Its files: the README line the agent wrote
